scientificBoundaries: Source geometry is explicitly interpreted, never experimentally authenticated. No fractional-to-Cartesian, 2D-to-3D, wrapping, vacuum insertion, bond inference or physical atom tracking is performed.

Only explicit T T T with a validated nine-component cell or F F F without cell is accepted. Partial periodicity and additional metadata remain unsupported by this TF profile, even when valid in general extXYZ.

Imported energy, forces, stress, charge, spin, unknown properties and unit/source annotations are rejected. Import leaves all scientific outputs null and solver admission abstaining; no automatic backend call.
Raw download preserves the accepted original bytes. Native export preserves the accepted structural document but not the raw header, formatting or transport provenance.
